rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a copy made by a photocopier.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 jing2 jan3 bun2 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this especially for a photocopied document or item submitted as part of paperwork.

example.english: When submitting the form, you need to attach a photocopy.
example.traditional: 交表嗰陣要附上影印件。
example.jyutping: gaau1 biu2 go2 zan6 jiu3 fu6 soeng6 jing2 jan3 gin6
